briefdescription.para: Inject a custom embedding backend for stub/test environments.

briefdescription.para: Inject a custom generation backend for stub/test environments.

detaileddescription.para: When set, generate() delegates to fn before using the built-in fail-closed stub path. This allows non-llama.cpp builds to forward text generation into an external backend while preserving the existing error response when no callback is configured.

briefdescription.para: Set an optional inference policy gate.

detaileddescription.para: When set, generate() and generateRAG() invoke this function before dispatching to the inference backend. The gate receives the request and an output parameter for a human-readable denial reason. Returning false causes the call to return success=false with the denial reason as error_message. Returning true allows inference to proceed.
This is the recommended integration point for governance policy engines (e.g. PolicyEngine::checkInferencePermission()) without introducing a compile-time dependency on the governance library.
Thread-safe: stored under mutex_.

parameterdescription.para: Callable matching PolicyFn; nullptr disables the gate (default).

briefdescription.para: Standalone llama_cpp plugin that wraps the existing LlamaWrapper and exposes it through the ILLMPlugin interface for dynamic loading.

detaileddescription.para: This plugin bridges the existing LlamaWrapper implementation with the plugin system. It can be loaded dynamically via THEMIS_LLM_PLUGIN() and registered in the PluginManager.

Usage without model (test/stub mode):
initialize() returns true without loading any model
generate() returns an empty InferenceResponse

Usage with model:
initialize() calls loadModel() with model_path from config

Streaming:
Set InferenceRequest::stream_callback to receive tokens one-by-one.
Alternatively call generateStream(request, callback) directly.

Batch inference:
generateBatch(requests) iterates over each request and calls generate().
